Rust-ochre geometric jute rug beneath bed with caramel leather tufted bench at foot. Woven seagrass basket containing folded burnt sienna cashmere throw at foreground rug edge. data.fullPrompt: Shot on Hasselblad X2D 100C, 24mm tilt-shift at f/8. Balanced contemporary bedroom with dark walnut storage bed centered against soft slate blue wall. Warm cream linen upholstered headboard 48 inches tall beneath 65 inch Samsung Frame TV wall-mounted at 60 inches. Burnt sienna cashmere throw draped diagonally across foot of bed.
